source_title: How TWOPAGES Connects Craftsmanship and Service to Simplify Custom Window Treatments
source_excerpt:
NEW YORK and LOS ANGELES and OTTAWA, ON , Oct. 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- For many homeowners, custom window treatments promise a perfect fit but deliver uncertainty. TWOPAGES is closing that gap by connecting vertically integrated manufacturing with professional support throughout the buying journey. Through its Behind the Curtain documentary series, TWOPAGES offers a closer look at the craftsmanship behind its custom window treatments.
From fabric development, dyeing, printing and embroidery to skilled manual cutting and sewing, shaping and quality inspection, TWOPAGES manages every major production stage with care and precision. Close attention to fabric behavior, measurements, seams and finishing helps ensure consistent quality, accurate dimensions, graceful drape and lasting performance. The brand offers 50+ collections and 1,000+ fabrics, with standard drapery production taking 3â7 days *.
Beyond craftsmanship, TWOPAGES pairs its manufacturing strength with three services supporting product selection, measurement, and installation.
Through its Design Consult Service , customers receive one-on-one guidance on fabrics, colors, hardware, and products based on their space, lifestyle, and budget. Zoom Measuring Consult provides real-time guidance; the first 20 minutes are complimentary. In eligible locations, the In-Home Measurement & Installation Service offers professional measurement or installation.
By linking front-end service with back-end production, TWOPAGES reduces uncertainty throughout the custom window treatment process.
For TWOPAGES, window treatments serve a purpose beyond decoration. They shape light, privacy, and comfort at home. Through thoughtful material selection, precise craftsmanship, and comprehensive support, the brand helps homeowners achieve these benefits more easily.
"We believe light shapes a space, and a space shapes how people feel. That is why every detail mattersâfrom the way a fabric filters natural light to the precision of its construction and the support customers receive throughout the process," said Ray Chen, Founder and CEO of TWOPAGES. "Our goal is not simply to make beautiful window treatments, but to help create homes where people can slow down, feel at ease, and be more present in everyday life."
Since 2015, TWOPAGES has served over 600,000 households worldwide, a record of trust built on craftsmanship, service, and a belief that a home should give people space to slow down, reconnect, and simply be.
To explore TWOPAGES custom window treatments and get expert help with design, measuring and installation, visit twopagescurtains.com .
*Production timelines vary for other categories, including Roman shades and bamboo shades.
